wavefunction: sum_r coefficient[r] * f_(a[r],b[r])(X X^T) * s^radial[r] * u^shape[r] * v^volume[r] * Y(X)^power[r] * seed[seed[r]](X)
number_encoding: Coefficient decimal strings and width rational strings denote their displayed real values; preserve every digit.
normalization: Lebesgue measure on R^(3x9), standard orthonormal fermion Fock basis; seed tensors include the common factor 1/sqrt(1144); coefficients already include all Cartesian, profile and dilation normalization factors.
seed_definitions: fermion-data.json: seeds, operator_definitions, equivariant_extension, singlet, quadratic_seed.
profile_pointwise_series: For eigenvalues g1,g2,g3 of G, eta=(a-b)/2 and K=k1+k2+k3: f_(a,b)=exp(-a*tr(G)/2)*sum_(k1,k2,k3>=0) product_j((1/2)_(kj)*(eta*gj)^kj/kj!)/(3/2)_K. (z)_k is the rising factorial, (z)_0=1. The series converges absolutely for every finite G.
